martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, Sunday's looking great for a cycle, especially around 17:00–19:00 when it's a pleasant 21°C with calm wind. You might even drag Britt along for a ride. The humidity's a bit of a concern, but it's nothing a cold drink after can't fix.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, Sunday's looking pretty sweet for a ride, especially between 17:00–19:00 when it's supposed to be calm and around 21°C. Watch out for some humidity and a chance of rain earlier on, but if you can squeeze it in after dinner, it should be great. Maybe drag Martha along and make a evening of it?
